annotations.title: Suggest AMSOIL products for a vehicle

description: Matches the viscosity grade and specification a vehicle's owner's manual lists to AMSOIL products, with shopping links carrying dealer referral zo=30734402 and the official AMSOIL lookup link for confirming the exact fit. It does not look up vehicles: give the requirements from the manual. Without them it returns questions to ask (needs) instead of guessing.

description.description: The vehicle or machine, for example "2020 Chevy Silverado 5.3L" or "Polaris RZR 1000 transmission". Viscosity and specification may be included here.

from_owners_manual.description: True only when the user read the viscosity and specification from the owner's manual.

specifications.description: Specifications from the owner's manual, for example "API SP, dexos1 Gen 3" or "Dexron VI".

vehicle_type.description: Optional; detected from the description when omitted (car = car, SUV, or gasoline light truck).

viscosity.description: Viscosity grade from the owner's manual, for example 0W-20.

name: suggest_for_vehicle
title: Suggest AMSOIL products for a vehicle
